Headline: Green and Orange Line Line Delays
ShortDescription: Green and Orange Line trains are running w/major delays following an earlier mechanical problem near Cermak. Service is resuming, allow extra time.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Green and Orange Line trains are running w/major delays and congestion following an earlier mechanical problem near Cermak.

Some trains and platforms may be busier than usual as crews work to restore normal service.

As a result of this delay: 

  • Orange Line shuttle buses are requested to provide connecting service between Halsted to Library in both directions, until 5:00pm.
  • Green Line shuttle buses are requested to provide connecting service between Cermak and Adams/Wabash in both directions, until 5:00pm.


Trains are moving and normal service is being restored.

Allow extra travel time.
